name: 12625-gsm8kstandalone-8b-1gpu
model: `NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` as the target and `unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct` as the draft, both served in float16. Both are ungated re-uploads of the `meta-llama` checkpoints -- same weights, same config.json shape fields -- and are used because the canonical ids are gated and there is no HuggingFace token on this machine.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. Both models live on the one GPU and share the request-to-token allocator.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, warmup the first 20% by completion, bounded at 512 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: `configs/data/gsm8k-8shot-1319.jsonl` -- the full 1319-question GSM8K test split in an 8-shot completion format. Prompts are 1265-1428 tokens (mean 1301) of which 24-187 (mean 60) are the question; answers run roughly 100-150 tokens and stop naturally. Single turn, greedy (temperature 0), `max_tokens` 512 with the stop sequences in scenario.json, sent to /v1/completions and not /v1/chat/completions, since a chat template would wrap this raw few-shot prompt in markup it never carried.
purpose: A grade-school math tutor solving worked word problems from long few-shot prompts, eight concurrent users, one GPU with a small draft model.
launch:
# sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id`.
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is DROPPED by the flat parser and the engine would
# then start without something this card declares.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tp-size: 1

# fp16, not the checkpoints' native bf16, on both models.
dtype: float16

# HAZARD: `speculative-num-draft-tokens: 6` is declared here because that is the setup's value,
# and the engine ADJUSTS IT TO 5 at startup, logging that it did -- `steps + 1` is forced whenever
# topk == 1. Target and draft share the Llama-3 tokenizer and vocab_size 128256; the engine
# asserts nothing about that at this commit.
speculative-algorithm: STANDALONE
speculative-draft-model-path: unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct
speculative-num-steps: 4
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 6

attention-backend: triton

# Decode graphs are captured for these running batches and nothing else.
cuda-graph-bs: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]

mem-fraction-static: 0.5

trust-remote-code: true

random-seed: 12625
